SELECT b.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName,
m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit,
mg.group_name AS categoryName,
SUM(bs.current_qty) AS currentQty, IFNULL(bmss.safe_stock_qty, 0) AS safeStockQty,
DATE_FORMAT(MIN(bs.expire_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS expireDate,
/* 상태 추가 */ CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(MIN(bs.expire_date), CURDATE()) <= 1 THEN 'urgent' WHEN DATEDIFF(MIN(bs.expire_date), CURDATE()) <= 3 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'normal' END AS expireStatus,
CASE WHEN SUM(bs.current_qty) <= 0 THEN 'out' WHEN SUM(bs.current_qty) < IFNULL(bmss.safe_stock_qty, 0) THEN 'low' ELSE 'normal' END AS status,
DATE_FORMAT(MAX(bs.received_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastUpdated
FROM branch_stock bs
JOIN branch b ON bs.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id LEFT JOIN branch_material_safety_stock bmss ON bmss.branch_code = bs.branch_code AND bmss.material_code = bs.material_code
WHERE 1=1
AND bs.branch_code = #{branchCode}
AND m.material_group_id = #{materialGroupId}
AND m.material_code = #{materialCode}
AND ( m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY b.branch_code, m.material_code
HAVING 1=1
AND DATEDIFF(MIN(bs.expire_date), CURDATE()) <= #{expireWithinDays}
AND SUM(bs.current_qty) < safeStockQty
SELECT name AS branchName, branch_code AS branchCode FROM branch
SELECT material_group_id AS materialGroupId, group_name AS groupName FROM material_group
SELECT material_code AS materialCode, material_name AS materialName FROM material WHERE material_group_id = 1 ORDER BY REPLACE(material_name, 'L', ''), LENGTH(material_name), material_name;
